rules.instruction: Cloud-first: GitHub/Drive remain the canonical SSOT; the local machine is runtime/checkout only, never the sole source of truth.
Every dispatched task must state AI, Project, Task, and Conversation/Session identifiers when applicable.

Research mature existing solutions first (Direct Use, then Wrap/Adapt, then Build); a comparison/report alone does not satisfy this gate, attempt a runnable PoC where reasonable, and record concrete rejection evidence before building from scratch.
Deliver any user-facing dispatch prompt as one complete copy-ready block; critical instructions may not be scattered outside it.
queued != running: never report an AI as running without real execution/provider evidence (execution_id and provider/session evidence).
User-visible usable progress outranks additional generalized infrastructure; internal component READY/PASS must not be reported as user-facing product completion.
Every ADM work report must include current progress, overall project progress, milestone progress, estimated remaining work/time, waiting/blocker, and the actual AI/provider currently running.
